question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.8
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'attributed.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options: 

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 attributed
 to say or think that something is the result of a particular thing. (यह कहना या सोचना कि कोई चीज किसी विशेष चीज का परिणाम है)
 
 

 indicated
 to show, point, or make clear in another way. (दूसरे तरीके से दिखाना, इंगित करना या स्पष्ट करना)
 
 

 dedicated
 believing that something is very important and giving a lot of time and energy to it. (यह मानना कि कुछ बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और इसे बहुत समय और ऊर्जा दे रहा है)
 
 

 distributed
 to give something out to several people, or to spread or supply something. (कई लोगों को कुछ देना, या कुछ फैलाना या आपूर्ति करना)
 
 
 
 

 
• Let's look at the sentence: "This has been **_________** to the eating of yams..."
 
• We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is the birth of twins to the Yoruba people is the result of the people's habit of eating yams.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "attributed" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​
